zh: 合数一定有不超过其平方根的素因子；32 位范围内的正数平方根不超过 46340，小于 2 的数（含 0、1 和负数）一律按非质数输出 Composite。
先用埃氏筛求出 46340 以内的所有素数；判断一个数时只需用这些素数试除到 p²>value，重复出现的数可以缓存结果。
筛出素数表；对每个输入值：若已缓存直接取结果；否则 value<2 判为 Composite，不然依次用素数 p 试除，p×p>value 时停止，能整除就是 Composite，都不能整除就是 Prime；每个结果占一行，空列表输出空文本。
en: A composite number always has a prime factor no larger than its square root; for positive 32-bit values that root is at most 46340, and every value below 2 (including 0, 1 and negatives) is printed as Composite.
Sieve all primes up to 46340 once; test a value by trial division with those primes until p² > value, and cache the verdict for repeated values.

Build the prime table with a sieve; for each input value use the cached verdict if there is one; otherwise a value < 2 is Composite, else divide by the primes in order, stopping once p * p > value: any exact division means Composite, none means Prime; print one verdict per line and nothing for an empty list.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sieve all primes up to 46340 and, for a positive number, trial-divide by prime factors until p²>value; numbers below 2 are non-prime directly, and the verdict for repeated values is cached.

## Proof of correctness

Every composite number has a prime factor no larger than its square root, since otherwise the product of its two smallest non-trivial factors would exceed the number itself. The square root of a 32-bit positive integer is at most 46340, so the sieve table contains every factor that can be needed; a number with a divisor is composite and one without is prime. Numbers below 2 are excluded by the definition of a prime. The cache only reuses the settled verdict of the same integer.

## Complexity

The sieve takes O(V log log V) time and each distinct positive number needs at most 4792 trial divisions, with V=46340; space is O(V+N).
